_comment: 来源：mod 仓库 _docs/data/units/玉海潮勇兵种设计.md；desc 取 loc unit_description_short_texts（中英原文）。长文尚未定稿（loc 里与短文同句），不写 story。

role.zh: 基础近战步兵 · T1 · 舰队招牌兵
role.en: Basic melee infantry · T1 · the fleet's signature troops

desc.zh: 玉海潮勇受过震旦水师的操练，他们会忠实执行舰长的任何命令。
desc.en: The Jade Sea Warriors are drilled in Cathayan naval discipline, and carry out their captain's orders without question.

v.zh: 护甲 40（皮甲）；木盾，35% 远程格挡
船长舱室（1 级）→ 提督卧舱（2 级）→ 提督议事厅（3 级）→ 舰队统帅厅（4 级）→ 玉海旗舰厅（5 级），游牧主城建筑全链
v.en: Captain's Cabin (tier 1) → Admiral's Quarters (2) → Admiral's Council Hall (3) → Fleet Command Hall (4) → Jade Sea Flagship Hall (5): the whole main horde building chain

v.zh: 建成船长舱室（1 级）即可，船上即招
v.en: Building the Captain's Cabin (tier 1); recruited aboard ship

desc.zh: 持木盾，格挡 35% 远程杀伤
desc.en: Carries a wooden shield that blocks 35% of missile damage

desc.zh: 作为阳相单位参与阴阳宁和
desc.en: Counts as a Yang unit for Battle Harmony
Fights in shallow water without penalty

wh3_main_unit_passive_battle_harmony_yan.zh: 阴阳宁和生效时：近战攻击 +4、近战防御 +4、领导力 +4
wh3_main_unit_passive_battle_harmony_yan.en: While in Battle Harmony: melee attack +4, melee defence +4, leadership +4

wh3_main_unit_passive_defensive_stance.zh: 两段式：战斗起手 10 秒抵御效能 ×1.1，随后常驻抵御效能 ×1.25、护甲 +10
wh3_main_unit_passive_defensive_stance.en: Two stages: bracing ×1.1 for the first 10 seconds of battle, then bracing ×1.25 and armour +10 for the rest of it

wh_dlc03_unit_passive_drunken.zh: 常驻：领导力 +4，附加精力充沛（免疫疲劳）；领导力跌至「动摇」及以下时自动失效
wh_dlc03_unit_passive_drunken.en: Always on: leadership +4 and Perfect Vigour (immune to fatigue); lost once the unit's leadership drops to Wavering or lower
